recognize_zh: 這是示意圖（非形態學影像）：以分支樹狀圖呈現骨髓瘤由 MGUS、SMM、MM 進展到漿細胞白血病（PCL）的克隆演化，每一階段有新的「打擊」與次克隆競爭，下方以漿細胞數量與形態逐漸增多、變大、出現雙核來表示疾病進展。
features: Branching phylogenetic trees depicting subclones at MGUS, SMM, MM, and PCL stages
Lightning bolts indicating additional genetic hits driving each transition from a myeloma progenitor cell
Labels: clonal advantage (MGUS), competition and selective pressure (SMM), migration and founder effect (PCL)
Lower row of schematic plasma cells increasing in number and becoming larger, rounder, and binucleate with progression
Thresholds of <10% versus >10% marrow plasma cells and an arrow indicating onset of clinical symptoms
describe_en: This non-morphologic schematic illustrates clonal evolution in plasma cell neoplasms. A myeloma progenitor cell acquires initiating lesions to form MGUS, and additional genetic hits generate branching subclones that compete under selective pressure through smoldering myeloma and symptomatic myeloma, culminating in plasma cell leukemia, where a subclone capable of independence from the marrow microenvironment expands through migration and a founder effect. The lower row depicts the corresponding increase in marrow plasma cell burden (<10% in MGUS, >10% in SMM and MM) and progressively more atypical plasma cell morphology. The key concept is intraclonal heterogeneity, which explains variable treatment response and relapse with different dominant clones.
